answer_1.quote: Radiology reports constitute a fundamental component of clinical workflows... The continued advancement of vision-language models has enabled the direct generation of medical reports from imaging data

answer_2.quote: Although these generated reports often attain high scores on standard natural language processing (NLP) metrics, such as BLEU and ROUGE-L ... we applied multiple existing evaluation metrics to all constructed report pairs ... including BLEU , ROUGE-L , METEOR , and BERTScore ... AlignScore ... RaTEScore ... CheXbert-F1 ... RadGraph-F1 ... GREEN

answer_3.quote: For each evaluation aspect listed in the Criteria Table, we prompted DeepSeek-R1 to rewrite the GT report by modifying only one targeted aspect ... Together, these two scores offer a comprehensive assessment of each metric's capacity to distinguish between clinically meaningful and negligible errors
methods: structured prompt to rewrite reports by altering specific clinical aspects

answer_4.quote: Based on consultations with clinicians and established clinical guidelines ... All generated report pairs were reviewed and validated by experienced clinicians to ensure consistency with real-world clinical understanding and relevance, with explanations provided alongside each pair ... Specifically, six radiologists annotated 50 ground-truth and generated report sets ... labeling the number of errors per report across six predefined categories
answer_4.guideline: annotated with clinical significance labels and explanations across diverse error types and evaluation aspects
